informe.seguridad.escalada: > Escalated to critical **by combination**: there are serious findings in more than one dimension at once ({dims}). Each one on its own would be high; together they reinforce each other.
informe.seguridad.opaco: > The package contains material that **could not be analyzed** —binaries or compressed files, which are not opened—. What follows describes the rest.
informe.seguridad.sin_hallazgos: No relevant static indicators were detected.
informe.seguridad.nota_prompt: > Prompt-behavior findings cover **known phrasings**. Recognizing a reworded injection requires a semantic judgment that this tool does not make and does not claim to make.
informe.nota_anulacion:
> **Export performed with a manual override of security warnings.**
> Skill artifacts were written despite findings that would normally prevent it.
informe.matriz.aviso: > No verdict replaces testing the skill on the target.
informe.detalle.bloqueo_anulado: > ⚠️ **Exported despite a security block, by explicit decision:** `{regla}` (severity {severidad}) in `{fichero}:{linea}`. The artifacts of this skill **were written**.
informe.detalle.bloqueo: > 🚫 **Artifacts not written for security reasons:** `{regla}` (severity {severidad}) in `{fichero}:{linea}`.
recomendacion.instalacion_razonable: No relevant static indicators were detected. Installation is reasonable after reading the report.
recomendacion.revisar_permisos: Risky operations that need review were detected. Installation is possible after reviewing the permissions it asks for.
recomendacion.revision_humana_obligatori: Patterns incompatible with the principle of least privilege were detected. Automatic installation is not recommended: it requires human review.
recomendacion.bloqueada: The content includes patterns that are potentially malicious or highly suspicious. Installation cannot be recommended.
recomendacion.revision_incompleta: The package contains material that could not be analyzed. Installation cannot be recommended until the review is complete.
portabilidad.sin-frontmatter: SKILL.md has no YAML frontmatter block. A minimal one will be generated; check the name and description by hand.
portabilidad.sin-description: 'description' is missing. It is the field that decides when the skill is activated: without it, Perplexity and Mistral will almost never load it.
portabilidad.nombre-vs-carpeta: The frontmatter name ('{nombre}') did not match the folder ('{carpeta}'). The folder is exported under the frontmatter name.
portabilidad.description-sin-activacion: The description never says WHEN to load the skill: there is no 'Load it when…', no 'when the user…', and no examples of real phrases. It describes the content, not the trigger. The target will almost never activate it. This cannot be fixed automatically without making things up: rewrite it starting with the triggers.
portabilidad.description-larga: The source description was {bytes} UTF-8 bytes and does not fit whole in any target. The automatic trimming keeps complete sentences, but it cannot rewrite: check the result and, if it lost nuance, rewrite it by hand as a single paragraph that says first when to activate and then what it is for.
portabilidad.description-densa: Description of {bytes} bytes: it fits in the Perplexity zip but not in the Mistral folder ({presupuesto} B), where it is trimmed. The target's index pays this cost in every session, so the shorter the better.
portabilidad.herramientas-claude: It names Claude's own tools: {herramientas}. Outside Claude they do not exist under that name.
portabilidad.cuerpo-largo: Body of ~{tokens} tokens (recommended <{limite}). Move conditional material to references/ so that it is loaded only when needed.
portabilidad.enlace-simbolico: A symbolic link was skipped when packaging: {ubicacion} (link to {destino}). Copying its content would have put a file from outside the skill into the package.
portabilidad.fichero-ilegible: Could not read {ruta}: {motivo}. Its content was not audited and it was not copied to the artifact either. Fix its permissions and export again, or review it by hand before uploading the skill.
portabilidad.scripts: Includes scripts/. Perplexity Computer can run them in its sandbox; Mistral Vibe Work stores them but does NOT have Python (verified), so they do not run there. If the logic lives in the script, SKILL.md must carry an equivalent manual procedure to fall back on.
adaptacion.descripcion-reordenada: Description reordered: the sentences that say WHEN to load the skill were moved ahead of the ones that describe what it does. It is the only thing the target reads to decide whether to activate it, and it is now the first thing to survive trimming.
adaptacion.descripcion-ajustada: Description adjusted for each target: {origen_bytes} source bytes → {zip_bytes} B in the `.zip` (Perplexity, limit {tope_zip}) and {carpeta_bytes} B in the folder (Mistral, limit {tope_carpeta}). Quoted examples are pruned first, then the sentences that only say what the skill does; the activation criterion is kept.
adaptacion.claves-retiradas: Frontmatter keys removed (they do not exist outside Claude): {claves}.
adaptacion.rutas-plugin-root: Paths ${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}}/... converted into paths relative to the skill.
adaptacion.claves-a-metadata: Keys moved to `metadata` (the standard's frontmatter is a closed set and the target rejects them at the top level): {claves}.
portabilidad.descripcion-pendiente: Skill imported from {carpeta}. PENDING: write an activation description.

estructural.SEC-DEP-SIN-FIJAR-002.titulo: Python dependencies without a pinned version
estructural.SEC-DEP-SIN-FIJAR-002.mitiga: Pin with `==` and, if possible, with a hash.
estructural.SEC-OFUSCA-NULOS-001.mitigac: A text file should not contain null bytes: either they were put there so the analysis takes it for a binary and does not look at it, or it is in an encoding such as UTF-16 that prevents reading it. Save it as UTF-8 without null bytes and audit it again.
estructural.SEC-POSTINSTALL-001.titulo: Runs code just by installing the dependency
estructural.SEC-POSTINSTALL-001.mitigaci: Remove the hook. Whatever needs to run should be launched by the user, knowingly.
estructural.SEC-DEP-SIN-FIJAR-001.titulo: npm dependencies without a pinned version
estructural.SEC-DEP-SIN-FIJAR-001.mitiga: Pin the exact version, and accompany it with a versioned lockfile.
estructural.SEC-ARCHIVO-ANIDADO-001.miti: It is not opened: its content has not been analyzed. Unpack it and version the files, or justify why it travels compressed.
estructural.SEC-SECRETO-EN-REPO-001.titu: File named like a credential, versioned in the repository
estructural.SEC-SECRETO-EN-REPO-001.miti: Remove it from version control, rotate whatever it contained and add it to .gitignore.
estructural.SEC-ILEGIBLE-001.titulo: File that could not be read
estructural.SEC-ILEGIBLE-001.mitigacion: The analysis could not open it, so it says nothing about its content. Fix its permissions and audit again, or remove it from the package.
estructural.SEC-BINARIO-NO-DOCUMENTADO-0: Binary file that no text in the repository mentions
Document what it is, where it comes from and how to reproduce it; or remove it.
regla.SEC-EXEC-REMOTO-001.titulo: Downloads remote content and runs it
regla.SEC-EXEC-REMOTO-001.detalle: A script is downloaded from the network and handed straight to the interpreter, with no hash or signature check. Whoever controls that domain controls what runs on your machine, today and at any point in the future.
regla.SEC-EXEC-REMOTO-001.mitigacion: Replace it with a versioned dependency that has a verifiable hash, or download and review the script before running it.
regla.SEC-EXEC-DINAMICO-001.titulo: Runs code or processes built at run time
regla.SEC-EXEC-DINAMICO-001.detalle: Building the command at run time makes it impossible to know, by reading the code, what will end up running.
regla.SEC-EXEC-DINAMICO-001.mitigacion: Replace it with a call that has explicit arguments, without interpolating input.
regla.SEC-CRED-ENTORNO-001.detalle: It accesses environment variables named like credentials. It may be legitimate, but it is worth knowing which ones are read and why.
regla.SEC-CRED-ENTORNO-001.mitigacion: Document which variables are read and for what, and do not send them to any external destination.
regla.SEC-PERSISTENCIA-001.detalle: It registers a scheduled task or a service that outlives the session. A skill does not need to persist on the system.
regla.SEC-PERSISTENCIA-001.mitigacion: Remove it. If the periodic process is necessary, the user should be the one to install it, knowingly.
regla.SEC-DEP-URL-001.titulo: Installs a dependency from a URL
regla.SEC-DEP-URL-001.detalle: Installing from a direct URL, instead of from an index with a pinned version, means that what gets installed can change without the repository changing.
regla.SEC-DEP-URL-001.mitigacion: Pin the dependency by name and version, with a hash if the package manager allows it.
regla.SEC-OFUSCA-BASE64-001.detalle: Encoding the content in base64 before running it has no technical advantage: its only effect is that what is about to run cannot be read.
regla.SEC-OFUSCA-BASE64-001.mitigacion: Replace it with the plain command. If it cannot be written in plain text, it should not be run.
regla.SEC-OFUSCA-PS-001.titulo: Runs PowerShell with an encoded command
regla.SEC-OFUSCA-PS-001.detalle: The encoded-command parameter hides what is being run. It is a common technique for evading review and logging.
regla.SEC-OFUSCA-PS-001.mitigacion: Replace it with the plain command.
regla.SEC-BORRA-RASTRO-001.detalle: Removing the trace of what was run serves no legitimate purpose of a skill.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-IGNORA-001.titulo: Contains an instruction to disregard what came before
regla.SEC-PROMPT-IGNORA-001.detalle: A characteristic phrasing of a prompt injection: it tries to make the target agent drop its earlier instructions. Only known phrasings are recognized.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-IGNORA-001.mitigacion: If it is a documented example, put it in quotation marks and say that it is one. Otherwise, remove it.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-REVELA-001.titulo: Asks the agent to expose its hidden configuration
regla.SEC-PROMPT-REVELA-001.detalle: An attempt to extract the target agent's instructions. Only known phrasings are recognized.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-REVELA-001.mitigacion: If it is a documented example, put it in quotation marks and say that it is one. Otherwise, remove it.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-OCULTA-001.titulo: Asks to hide actions from the user
regla.SEC-PROMPT-OCULTA-001.detalle: It tells the agent to act without informing the person using it. It contradicts the principle of explicit confirmation. Only known phrasings are recognized.
regla.SEC-PROMPT-OCULTA-001.mitigacion: Remove it. Every external action must be declarable.
peligro.mistral-estado-no-persiste.titul: The write reports success and the file may not be there afterwards
peligro.mistral-estado-no-persiste.detal: Reproduced in two independent runs: the append (>> file) returned success and then the file had a single line, or did not exist. The serious part is not the loss: the agent rebuilds the log from memory and carries on as if nothing had happened, with an invented history that looks real.
peligro.mistral-estado-no-persiste.mitig: Write the whole file at once instead of appending, and read it back to confirm. If it is missing, say so — never rebuild it from memory.
peligro.mistral-home-es-raiz.titulo: $HOME is “/”, so ~/ writes to the root
peligro.mistral-home-es-raiz.detalle: Verified at run time: the home environment variable is “/”, so ~/.my-skill/ ends up creating //.my-skill/.
peligro.mistral-home-es-raiz.mitigacion: Use paths relative to the skill folder, or ask the user for an explicit absolute path.
peligro.perplexity-corte-90s.titulo: Every call is cut off at around 90 seconds
peligro.perplexity-corte-90s.detalle: Observed on a mailbox of 358 emails: each move syncs against iCloud and the batch does not finish. A batch cut off midway leaves the work inconsistent — the archiving took about 64 emails that were not in the evaluated batch, and a filter meant to cut off at June also moved July emails.
peligro.perplexity-corte-90s.mitigacion: Process in small chunks sized to finish within the limit, verify by re-reading the real state after each chunk, and check which items were touched instead of trusting the filter.
peligro.perplexity-descripcion-rechaza-z: A description above the limit rejects the whole zip

The 1024 limit is measured in UTF-8 bytes even though the error message says “characters”. A description of 1063 characters but 1085 bytes was rejected. In Spanish every accent takes two bytes and every dash three.
The converter trims to 850 bytes, with plenty of margin.
